# Riveters Tampa

> Bar & Grill in Tampa, Florida. Scratch kitchen, a wall of TVs and a bar built around Rosie the Riveter, open late most nights.

- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Burgers and handhelds; Pretzel and wings; Loaded dogs
